newsitem.title: UK: Nerefco 55 kbpd cat cracker down "for a few days".
newsitem.headline: Nerefco 55 kbpd cat cracker down "for a few days".

text.p: The Nerefco refinery's 55,000 barrel per day catalytic cracker was shut on Friday and would be down "for a few days" because of production problems, an official at the BP/Texaco joint venture in Rotterdam told Reuters.
"We have taken the unit down to fix a few things," said the official, who asked not to be named. "We took it down this morning and it will be down for a few days."
"It's happened before so we know what we have to do to fix it," he added.
The shutdown adds to the woes of the European gasoline market, which has already been hit by problems at one of the two catalytic crackers at the nearby Pernis complex.
The Shell facility is shutting immediately for a three month maintenance period, a month longer than anticipated, reducing gasoline output by 100,000 tonnes a month (28,000 barrels per day).
